chapterTitle: Chapter 18 Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
title: Problem 18-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 18-5 How would you prepare the following ethers? Use whichever method you think is more appropriate, Williamson synthesis or the alkoxymercuration reaction. (a) Butyl cyclohexyl ether (b) Benzyl ethyl ether (C6H5CH2OCH2CH3) (c) sec-Butyl tert-butyl ether (d) Tetrahydrofuran
